verdict.S1: MISS: twist label is the colour content ct(lambda); hbar-expansion of the background trace has positive coefficients only (8 hbar, 4N hbar^2 at n=2); the only negative constant is the sl-framing shift -1/N, N-dependent. 1-1/3 at N=3 is the pre-declared coincidence.
verdict.S2: MISS: Hecke-sign-weighted susceptibility q(N+2)-q^-1(N-2); q=1 ratio 2/N (swap l^2=4 over 2N), N-dependent. 2/3 at N=3 is the pre-declared coincidence.
verdict.S3: MISS (no split): background susceptibility of a braid word at q=1 is sum l_i^2 N^(#cyc-1): a strand cycle of length l couples like charge l (l^2 'paramagnetic-like'), with no opposite-sign diamagnetic term; heat-kernel per-state susceptibility 1 -> 12/17, sign of the RG reading set by the background convention.
